text: …ポケモン　てちょう　…ポケモン　グラフ
note: The titles imitate real Japanese magazine names: グラフ ("Graph") is a usual title word for photo magazines, such as Asahi Graph. The English game put "Pokémon Insider" and "Pokémon Fan" instead.
claim: Asahi Graph (アサヒグラフ) was a Japanese pictorial magazine.

check.quote: Asahigraph (アサヒグラフ, Asahigurafu), also known as the Asahi Picture News, was a Japanese weekly pictorial magazine that ran from 1923 until 2000.
check.note: The titles imitate real Japanese magazine names: グラフ ("Graph") is a usual title word for photo magazines, such as Asahi Graph. The English game put "Pokémon Insider" and "Pokémon Fan" instead.
